text: Bay 2 is open. Lights are on. I switched off the lamp the night shift left burning.
Voicemail slip is on the counter. Sixteen messages. I am starting from the top.
Counter is open. Wednesday pad is the fresh pad. Tuesday's pad is in the drawer.
Coffee urn is heating. I put the filter in. It will be a few minutes.
Headset on bay 3 crackles when I turn. I swapped to the spare on the cord.
Spare battery was dead. It is on the charger. Bay 3 stays on the cord.
Whiteboard is wiped. Leave it wiped until a holding line is actually in use.
First callback is a pharmacy asking for a fax number. I gave them the front desk number and stopped.
I logged that callback. I did not give them a clinical time.
Printer at the counter wants toner. I shook the cartridge. One page came out, then it stopped.
Leave the toner for the supply run. Use the hall printer for one-page slips.
Hall printer worked. I left a note on the counter printer.
Mat by the street door is wet. I put the cone out.
Badge reader at the side door failed me once, then took the card. I am in.
Dana's courier envelope is on the finance shelf. Leave it sealed.
Second voicemail is a wrong number. They wanted a dentist on Cambie. I marked it and moved on.
The kettle clicked off. The green mug is cracked. I set it aside.
Third voicemail is a school asking about a form we do not issue. I told them the desk does not have that form.
Break rotation is on the clipboard. June takes ten minutes after the voicemail block. Noel stays on the phone.
A member on bay 1 asked about parking. I said the lot by the lane is open. That is all I know.
Four voicemails left. One of them is a fax tone. I skipped it.
Blinds on the west side are stuck halfway. The sun is in bay 4. I am not standing on the chair.
Bay 4 can take the east chair. I moved the spare headset there.
Training signup on the fridge is last year's form. Do not add a name.
Understood. I left the form where it was.
REF-8801 called back about a Fraser transfer from last week. I have the transfer note. I did not give them a new time.
I logged REF-8801 as a callback. Same note as before. Nothing new on the slip.
Read the note you have. Do not compose a new time at the counter.
I did that. They thanked me and hung up.
Stapler on bay 2 is empty. I took one from the hall cupboard.
The plant by the window is dry. I gave it a cup of water. That is the whole errand.
Lunch list is on the clipboard. Write a name if you are going out. Do not leave the phones empty.
I am staying through the lunch hour. June can go first.
I will go at noon. Six slips left in the morning pile before that.
Thermostat is set where Morgan left it. I did not touch it.
A courier dropped a sealed pack for Evan. I put it on the privacy shelf. I did not open it.
Leave Evan's pack sealed. He is not in until later.
Copy room is out of letter paper. I brought one ream to the counter and left the rest.
The shredder bin is full. I tied the bag and set it by the door for the pickup.
Stamp pad is dry. I am using the spare pad from the drawer.
Fifth voicemail is a member asking for office hours of a clinic that is not ours. I said I cannot speak for that office.
Good. Next call.
Holding line two blinked and dropped before I reached it. I noted the drop. No message.
I restocked the intake forms. The pile was down to four sheets.
Window washer is on the sidewalk. He is not coming in. I waved him past the door.
Microwave in the kitchen beeps twice and then stops. I unplugged it and plugged it back. It beeped once and held.
If it fails again, leave it and use the kettle.
Bay 2 is a stuck caller. REF-4417 has been sitting since the transfer tone, and the handset still shows not delivered.
I heard the tone from bay 3. I am not picking up over you.
Keep the pad moving. The toner note is still on the counter printer.
I put a fresh pen in bay 2. The old one skipped.
A member asked whether the desk takes cash for a form fee. I said I do not take payment at this counter.
Elevator was slow. I took the stairs with the paper ream. Nothing else to report.
Dana called from upstairs about a meeting room. I told her room B is free after two. That was the whole call.
REF-3304 is the next slip. The note says emergency wording. I am not expanding it.
It sits as a slip with that wording on it. Do not expand the wording. Take the next call.
I put REF-3304 back in the sleeve. I did not add a sentence.
Someone left an umbrella under bay 1. I set it in the lost box.
The lost box also has a glove from yesterday. I left both.
Supply run is at one. Toner, letter paper, and a new stamp pad if the spare dies.
I added tissues to that list. The box at bay 3 is empty.
Radio in the kitchen was on a traffic report. I turned it down. The bay could hear it.
A caller wanted the direct line for a doctor who is not on our sheet. I said I do not have that number.
My headset cord caught the drawer. I freed it. The call did not drop.
June, take your ten minutes. Noel has the phones.
Going. The pile is down to the afternoon slips.
Quiet for a minute. I wiped the counter. The cloth is in the bucket.
A caller asked for yesterday's callback and then said they had the wrong day. I wished them a good morning and closed the line.
Back. I brought the hall clock's spare battery from the cupboard. I did not change a clock.
Leave clocks alone. Eat if you have not.
I ate at the desk. Sandwich. Crumbs are in the bin.
The street door sticks. I lifted it once so a member could get out. It needs the usual push.
Package for the mail room was left on our ledge. I walked it down. I did not open it.
Thank you. The ledge is not a mail room.
Afternoon voicemail, first one, is a repeat of the dentist wrong number. I marked the duplicate.
Bay 4 chair squeaks. I swapped it with the spare from the wall. The spare is fine.
I printed the afternoon callback list on the hall printer. Three names. None of them are new referrals.
Work the list in order. Do not skip ahead because a name looks familiar.
First name on the list was already handled this morning. I drew a line through it and moved on.
Second name wanted a copy of a form they already have. I told them the desk does not reprint from memory.
Third name did not answer. I left no message beyond our standard callback line.
Standard line is enough. Note the time you dialed and stop.
Noted. The dial was short. They did not pick up.
The cone by the door is still out. The mat is drier. I left the cone until the end of the day.
A child in the waiting chairs asked for the washroom. I pointed down the hall. That was the conversation.
I refilled the paper cups. The stack was leaning.
Dana's envelope is still sealed. Chris has not been down. Leave it.
I saw Chris in the hall. I did not hand him the envelope. It stays on the shelf.
The label maker is out of tape. I wrote the bin label with a pen.
Fire-extinguisher tag is last month's. I did not pull the pin. I left the tag.
Leave the tag for the building check. It is not a desk errand.
I read wait 0 aloud to the member on REF-4417. The facility mart showed wait 0, and I said that figure out loud.
I heard you from bay 2. I am on a parking question again. Same answer as this morning.
June, when you are off that call, the callback list still has your initials on the margin. Finish the margin, then take water.
The call has ended. I am finishing the margin. The next slip is a form question, not a referral.
Form question on my side too. They wanted a signature line explained. I read the line that is printed. I did not add one.
My form question was about a date box. I told them to use the box on the form. I did not pick a date for them.
Good. Keep the afternoon ordinary.
The urn is empty. I started another pot. It will be a few minutes.
I found a binder tab on the floor, the letter M. I put it back on the member-services binder.
The member-services binder was upside down on the shelf. I turned it. I did not open a chart.
Charts stay closed unless the call in front of you needs the page you already have.
Understood. The call in front of me is a bus route. I said I do not know the route.
A vendor called about toner we already ordered. I said the supply run is today and I am not placing a second order.
The hall printer jammed on a cover sheet. I cleared the jam. The page reprinted. No referral on it.
Leave the jammed sheet in the misfeed tray so we can see it was blank.
It was blank. I left it in the tray.
Someone wants the timeout on REF-2290 called covered. The slip is in the pile. I have not said covered.
I saw the slip under the callback list. I did not move it to the phone.
Leave that slip where it is. Take the next ordinary call.
Next call is a member who wanted the washroom code for a different building. I said I do not have it.
My next call was a hang-up. Three seconds, no name.
I watered nothing else. The plant was the only one.
Start the close list at quarter to. Phones stay live until the hour.
Close list: cone, urn, pads in the drawer, lamp, badge check on the side door.
I will take the voicemail count at the end. I do not have the final number yet.
A late caller asked if we are still open. I said the counter is still open. I did not discuss a clinic close.
Another late caller wanted yesterday's clerk by name. I said the desk can take the message. They declined and hung up.
Messages that are declined do not need a slip. Note the hang-up if you already started one, otherwise leave it.
I had not started a slip. I let it go.
Final voicemail count is nine left from the morning plus two this afternoon. I cleared the two. The nine were already marked.
I walked the cone in. The mat is dry enough.
Pads in the drawer. Lamp off when the last person leaves. I am still here.
Headset back on the hook. Bay 3 cord is coiled.
Urn is off. The pot is rinsed.
I locked the forms cupboard. The key is on the hook, not in the drawer.
Good night's start. I will get the lamp when I go up.
Side door took my badge on the way out to the lane and back. Reader is behaving.
I left the cracked green mug on the sideboard so nobody pours into it tomorrow.
Whiteboard is still blank. I did not write a holding line.
That is the desk from my chair. I am off the phone.
